title: Restore nearby scene grain in local AI Remove fills
notes: Local LaMa keeps the native linear source, matches fill colour from unmasked context, and restores only missing luminance/chroma noise variance from nearby unstructured blocks. Existing model noise is counted first; unsupported samples use a conservative no-addition fallback. New local fills are stored losslessly; existing saved patches and ordinary renders are unchanged. No model or download changes.
